text: Fever may require clinical review, especially if it is persistent, severe, or accompanied by worsening symptoms.
A mild headache can have many causes. Seek clinical review if the headache is severe, persistent, sudden, or associated with other concerning symptoms.
Diarrhea can cause dehydration. Oral rehydration solution may help replace lost fluids while clinical review should be sought if symptoms are severe or persistent.
A persistent cough should be clinically reviewed, especially when accompanied by fever, breathing difficulty, chest pain, or worsening symptoms.
Possible malaria symptoms require appropriate clinical assessment and testing before treatment decisions are made.
